lead: Competitive intelligence signals across the rolling year highlight active EFB, flight planning, and operational platform adoption, with vendor wins concentrated among specific airline segments.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple LCC and Regional Carrier Wins for EFBOne
insights.finding: IFS captured multiple customer wins for its IFS EFBOne platform, notably being selected by fastjet and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is classified as an African low-cost carrier (LCC), and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) is classified as an LCC.
insights.caveat: Captured feed visibility indicates active contract announcements but does not represent total market share.

insights.title: Thales and Aviobook Secure Long-Term Royal Air Maroc Agreement
insights.finding: Thales and Aviobook signed a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to deploy the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a full-service international carrier.

insights.title: Jeppesen Expands ForeFlight Capabilities with New Airflow Agents
insights.finding: Jeppesen announced new Airflow agents, including Trip Feasibility and Ops Briefing, for its ForeFlight Dispatch platform at NBAA-BACE 2026.
insights.aviation_context: Targeted primarily toward business and commercial aviation dispatch operations.
insights.caveat: Announcements reflect product releases and feature additions rather than guaranteed live deployments.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Releases Lido mPilot 7.3 with Enhanced Airport Moving Maps
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems released Lido mPilot 7.3, introducing aircraft-specific taxiway restrictions directly onto Airport Moving Maps.
insights.aviation_context: EFB navigation application feature update aimed at pilot situational awareness.
insights.caveat: Feature release captured via LinkedIn update.

insights.title: Navblue Expands TransNusa Collaboration for Skywise Integration
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue by signing for Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+ to integrate flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa operates regional and domestic scheduled services.
insights.caveat: First agreement for these specific products in Indonesia as reported in company releases.
